questions.questionText: Imran ranks 15th from the top in a class of 66 students. What is Imran's rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = total − rank from top + 1 = 66 − 15 + 1 = 52.
questions.shortcut: Rank from other end = Total + 1 − given rank.

questions.questionText: Kiran ranks 46th from the top in a class of 60 students. What is Kiran's rank from the bottom?

questions.questionText: Sneha is 16th from the left and 15th from the right in a row. How many persons are there in the row?
questions.explanation: Total = 16 + 15 − 1 = 30; Sneha is counted in both ranks, so subtract 1.
questions.shortcut: Total = Left + Right − 1.

questions.questionText: Padma is 9th from the front and 16th from the back in a queue. How many persons are there in the queue?

questions.questionText: Prakash is 16th from the left and 6th from the right in a shelf of books. How many books are there in the shelf of books?
questions.explanation: Total = 16 + 6 − 1 = 21; Prakash is counted in both ranks, so subtract 1.
questions.shortcut: Total = Left + Right − 1.

questions.questionText: In a row of 47 persons, Kavya is 17th from the left end and Harleen is 17th from the right end. How many persons are standing between Kavya and Harleen?
questions.explanation: Persons not between them = 17 (up to and including Kavya) + 17 (from Harleen to the right end) = 34. Between = 47 − 34 = 13.
questions.shortcut: Between = Total − (Left rank + Right rank).

questions.questionText: In a row of 41 persons, Anita is 8th from the left end and Lakshmi is 7th from the right end. How many persons are standing between Anita and Lakshmi?

questions.shortcut: Between = Total − (Left rank + Right rank).

questions.questionText: In a row of 30 persons, Pooja is 6th from the left end and Prakash is 18th from the right end. How many persons are standing between Pooja and Prakash?

questions.questionText: In a row of 42 persons, Gurpreet is 16th from the left. If Gurpreet moves 3 places towards the right, what will be Gurpreet's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: New left position = 16 + 3 = 19. Right position = 42 − 19 + 1 = 24.
questions.shortcut: New right rank = Old right rank − shift.

questions.questionText: Sathish stands exactly in the middle of a row of 69 persons. Priya stands 9 places to the right of Sathish. What is Priya's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Middle position = (69+1)/2 = 35 from either end. Priya is 9 places nearer the right end, so rank from right = 35 − 9 = 26.
questions.shortcut: Middle of odd N is (N+1)/2; moving right reduces right rank.

questions.questionText: Ravi stands exactly in the middle of a row of 51 persons. Kavya stands 4 places to the right of Ravi. What is Kavya's position from the right end?

questions.questionText: Rahul is 17th from the left and 9th from the right in a row. Then 4 more persons join at the right end and 9 more join at the left end. What is Rahul's new position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Persons joining the right end each add 1 to the right rank; those joining the left end do not change it. New right rank = 9 + 4 = 13.
questions.shortcut: Only joiners on the side you are counting from change that rank.

questions.questionText: Balaji is 9th from the left and 18th from the right in a row. Then 9 more persons join at the right end and 3 more join at the left end. What is Balaji's new position from the right end?

questions.questionText: In a class of 41 students, Padma is 6th from the top. Sneha is ranked 17 places below Padma. What is Sneha's rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Sneha's rank from top = 6 + 17 = 23. Rank from bottom = 41 − 23 + 1 = 19.
questions.shortcut: Top rank of the lower student = 6 + gap; then flip with Total + 1.

questions.questionText: In a class of 61 students, Nisha is 7th from the top. Lakshmi is ranked 13 places below Nisha. What is Lakshmi's rank from the bottom?

questions.shortcut: Top rank of the lower student = 7 + gap; then flip with Total + 1.

questions.questionText: In a row of 49 persons, Jaya is 18th from the left and Mohan is 18th from the right (Jaya is to the left of Mohan). Sanjay stands exactly in the middle of the persons standing between Jaya and Mohan. What is Sanjay's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Persons between Jaya and Mohan = 49 − (18+18) = 13. The middle one of these is the 7th after Jaya, at position 18 + 7 = 25 from the left. From the right: 49 − 25 + 1 = 25.
questions.shortcut: Middle of an odd group of b people is the (b+1)/2-th one.

questions.questionText: In a row of 43 persons, Mohan is 24th from the left and Ishita is 12th from the right (Mohan is to the left of Ishita). Dinesh stands exactly in the middle of the persons standing between Mohan and Ishita. What is Dinesh's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Persons between Mohan and Ishita = 43 − (24+12) = 7. The middle one of these is the 4th after Mohan, at position 24 + 4 = 28 from the left. From the right: 43 − 28 + 1 = 16.
questions.shortcut: Middle of an odd group of b people is the (b+1)/2-th one.
